title: Sustainable valorization of wheat bran through solid-state fermentation and enzymatic bioprocessing for enhanced antioxidant potential
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,3023-3034
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00564G, Paper

Tapati Bhanja Dey, Subhojit Chakroborty, Ramesh Chander Kuhad
SSF of WB with Trichoderma sp. RCK65 increased phenolics, antioxidants and amino acids. Fermented biomass retained high antioxidant levels even after enzyme extraction. Enzymatic treatment also improved antioxidant activity and ferulic acid yield.
